phases.name: foundation
phases.focus: build baseline movement quality and conditioning while preparing for progressive overload

phases.name: hypertrophy 1
phases.focus: establish progressive resistance with moderate volume to drive muscle growth

phases.name: hypertrophy 2
phases.focus: increase training stimulus and refinement for hypertrophy and strength balance

non_negotiables: Safety: New client — 26, female, strict vegan (no animal products, fish, eggs, or dairy), recreational lifter
Safety: 150g protein/day from plant sources only

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week vegan muscle gain program for recreational lifter (full gym)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary fitness:
    name "Muscle gain with plant-based protein target 150g/day"
PHASES
  PHASE "foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY upper training 60m "FoundationUpper":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          shoulder_stability 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY lower training 60m "FoundationLower":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
          leg_m swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120s
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90s
          hamstring_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90s
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY push training 60m "FoundationPush":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2m
          pushups 8 reps
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
          chest_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY pull training 60m "FoundationPull":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
          nass 2m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
  PHASE "hypertrophy 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY upper training 60m "Hy1Upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY lower training 60m "Hy1Lower":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 2m
          calf_raise 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY push training 60m "Hy1Push":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2m
          pushups 8 reps
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          dips (assisted if needed) 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY pull training 60m "Hy1Pull":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
          light row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90s
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
          bicep_stretch 2m
  PHASE "hypertrophy 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY upper training 60m "Hy2Upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90s
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY lower training 60m "Hy2Lower":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 2m
          calf_raise 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120s
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 8 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY push training 60m "Hy2Push":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2m
          pushups 10 reps
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90s
          shoulder_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90s
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7.5 rest 60s
          chest_fly 3x12 rpe 7.5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY pull training 60m "Hy2Pull":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
          light row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 8 rest 90s
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7.5 rest 60s
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7.5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
          bicep_stretch 2m

NON_NEGOTIables
  Safety: Full gym access
  Safety: New client — 26, female, strict vegan (no animal products, fish, eggs, or dairy), recreational lifter
  Safety: 150g protein/day from plant sources only
